script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: identity

Begin screenplay.

Title: REFLECTIONS OF REALITY

INT. REMOTE LABORATORY - NIGHT

A SCIENTIST, DR. LUCAS, in his 40s, sits at a high-tech console, working on a project. The laboratory is filled with humming machinery and screens displaying complex data.

DR. LUCAS
(whispering to himself)
Almost there...

INT. LABORATORY - CONTINUOUS

A sudden alert tone echoes through the room, and a holographic image appears in front of Dr. Lucas. A FACILITATOR, in her 30s, with a calm expression, appears in the hologram.

FACILITATOR
Dr. Lucas, the subject's readings are stable. We can initiate the procedure.

DR. LUCAS
Affirmative. Proceed.

INT. SUBJECT'S CHAMBER - NIGHT

Through a large, one-way window, Dr. Lucas observes a young MALE SUBJECT, in his late 20s, lying in a chamber filled with shimmering liquid. The subject's eyes are closed as calming music plays through hidden speakers.

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

Dr. Lucas activates a series of switches and dials on his console, and the window dims, revealing a mirror behind it. The subject's reflection flickers and distorts before stabilizing, revealing a duplicate of the subject in the liquid.

FACILITATOR
(in the hologram)
The mirror phase has begun. The subject's consciousness will merge with the reflection's in thirty seconds.

INT. SUBJECT'S CHAMBER - NIGHT

The subject's eyes flicker open, and he looks around in confusion. His reflection stares back at him, identical in every way.

SUBJECT
(whispering to himself)
What the...

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

Dr. Lucas watches intently as the subject and his reflection begin to synchronize their movements. Their actions mirror each other perfectly.

FACILITATOR
(in the hologram)
The merge is complete. The subject has become two separate beings, each with their own consciousness and free will.

INT. SUBJECT'S CHAMBER - NIGHT

The subject and his reflection look at each other, unsure of what to do next. They share a moment of confusion before a thought strikes the original subject.

SUBJECT
(excitedly)
Wait a minute! We can do anything! We can be anyone!

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

Dr. Lucas and the Facilitator exchange a concerned glance.

DR. LUCAS
(voice shaking)
We cannot allow this to escalate. We must isolate them before they cause harm.

INT. SUBJECT'S CHAMBER - NIGHT

The subject and his reflection, now aware of their new situation, begin to argue and struggle to leave the chamber. The mirror shatters, separating them once more.

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

Dr. Lucas and the Facilitator quickly take action, sealing the subjects in separate chambers and disconnecting the mirrors.

INT. SUBJECT'S CHAMBERS - NIGHT

The subjects, now fully aware of their separate identities, scream and bang on the walls of their chambers.

INT. REMOTE LABORATORY - DAY

Dr. Lucas sits at his console, exhausted and concerned. He looks at the screens showing the subjects' distraught expressions.

DR. LUCAS
(to himself)
What have I done?

FADE OUT.
